answer: Dynamic opportunity-cost bonds lock staking collateral into a time-varying yield, creating a ridge of marginal expense that grows with each Sybil identity. A subgame-perfect punishment matrix couples slashing penalties to a zero-knowledge verifiable delay, driving negative expected attack utility below the nadir of rational gain. Consequently, any adversary faces a dune of loss and the protocol settles at a robust Nash equilibrium where honest participation dominates.
